title: Astro Portal session event payload: guiding_spikes
description: A group of guiding spikes (an error beyond the threshold outside a dither settle) found by Astro Sync in the guiding log: `count` of them, up to `maxArcSeconds` (arcseconds), from `firstAt` to `lastAt`. One event per group, like guiding_timeouts. The instant of the event is its `recordedAt`, the first spike. See session-events.md.

description.description: Optional sentence for an application that does not know this type: it shows it as an ordinary report. The applications that know the type compose their own sentence, in the person's language, from the structured fields.
